description: Metadata for public Centre for the Governance of AI HTML pages on www.governance.ai. Each canonical URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. Rows store the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text and PDFs are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Rights stay unknown unless that page states a reuse licence that allows copying. A public page is not a licence. Research papers, analysis posts, update posts, and staff profiles are not listed. runner_wired is false.
